title: A Spectral Dichotomy for Dilworth Multiplicity Bounds of the Signless Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian on C-Graphs and Cographs
description: The manuscript gives non-local eigenvalue multiplicity bounds for connected C-graphs and shows that the same bounds fail for general connected cographs. Theorem 5.3 gives linear upper bounds for cographs. Theorem 5.4 constructs a family in which the excess over the Dilworth number grows linearly.
